descriptionByLocale.it: Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact - The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making. Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance. - Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets. - Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI). - Develop attribution models (e.g. media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency. - Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes. - Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth. - Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights. Your Journey so far - 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis. - Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies. - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred). Your Essentials - Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. - Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy - Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences. - Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms. - Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English. - Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem. Your Impact - Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates. - Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem. - Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users. - Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem. - Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem. - Drive MSC for Me channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base. - Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation. Your Journey so far - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field. - Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications. - Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus). - Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations. - Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend. - Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Your Essentials - Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems. - Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience. - Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines. VISA REQUIREMENTS (if any) : - Right to work in Switzerland. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

- Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility.

- Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms.

- Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration.

- Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry.

- Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software).

- Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams.

- International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations.

- Willingness to travel extensively.

Your Essentials

- SWISS Resident or Visa Holder

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore Finanze e Contabilità – Nuovi Investimenti porterà la supervisione finanziaria, la contabilità e la gestione delle prestazioni per i nuovi Investimenti Strategic Value Chain (“SVCI”) della società. Questo ruolo gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire forti controlli finanziari e collaborare con team interfunzionali per ottimizzare la redditività attraverso operazioni di crociera non core. Il candidato ideale porta una miscela di competenze di contabilità tecnica, finanza commerciale acumen, e l'esperienza di sostenere gli ambienti orientati agli investimenti o multi-business. Il tuo impatto Gestione finanziaria e reporting - Controllare la contabilità, fine mese vicino, e la rendicontazione finanziaria per SVCI - Assicurare il riconoscimento accurato dei ricavi, l'allocazione dei costi e l'analisi dei margini per SVCI - Preparare e rivedere rapporti di gestione, KPI e analisi di varianza per sostenere le decisioni aziendali - Mantenere il rispetto dei controlli interni, degli standard contabili e delle politiche aziendali Nuovi investimenti e valutazione aziendale - Traccia le prestazioni post-investimento rispetto al piano e identifica rischi e opportunità di miglioramento Bilancio e previsione - Assistere gli investimenti e il gruppo durante i processi di budget e rolling forecast - Partner con i leader operativi per sviluppare ipotesi realistiche e obiettivi finanziari - Monitorare le prestazioni contro i bilanci e fornire informazioni attuabili Supporto trasversale - Agire come partner finanziario per sostenere potenziali sinergie all'interno degli investimenti. - Collaborare con i team legali, del Tesoro, delle Operazioni e Commerciali su strutture contrattuali, modelli di prezzi e implicazioni finanziarie - Supportare iniziative strategiche relative all'espansione, all'innovazione e all'ottimizzazione di nuovi investimenti Miglioramento dei processi e sistemi - Migliorare i processi finanziari, segnalare l'automazione e la qualità dei dati nelle attività di investimento - Supporta l'implementazione o la valorizzazione di ERP, strumenti di reporting o sistemi finanziari secondo le necessità - Identificare le opportunità di scalare i processi di finanza come nuove imprese crescono Il tuo viaggio finora - Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Contabilità o campo relativo (CPA, ACA, ACCA, o equivalente fortemente preferito) con uno sfondo Big 4 - 6-10 anni di esperienza progressiva nella finanza e nella contabilità, compreso l'esposizione agli investimenti, o ambienti multi-entity - Esperienza nell'ospitalità, viaggio, crociera, vendita al dettaglio, servizi di consumo, o le industrie asset-heavy è un vantaggio forte - Solida comprensione della modellazione finanziaria, del bilancio, della previsione e del reporting gestionale - Forte conoscenza dei principi contabili IFRS e dei controlli finanziari - Fluente in inglese, francese e/o italiano sono un plus I tuoi essenziali - Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving con una mentalità commerciale - Capacità di tradurre i dati finanziari in chiare informazioni per gli stakeholder non finanziari - Confortevole lavoro in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione con più stakeholder - Alta attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di vedere il grande quadro - Ottima comunicazione e capacità di costruzione di relazioni Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). This role plays a critical part in ensuring strong financial controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize profitability across non-core cruise operations. The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial finance acumen, and experience supporting investment-driven or multi-business environments. Your Impact Financial Management & Reporting - Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI - Ensure accurate revenue recognition, cost allocation, and margin analysis for SVCI - Prepare and review management reports, KPIs, and variance analyses to support business decisions - Maintain compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies New Investments & Business Evaluation - Track post-investment performance versus plan and identify risks and improvement opportunities Budgeting & Forecasting - Assist the investments and the group during budgeting and rolling forecast processes - Partner with operational leaders to develop realistic assumptions and financial targets - Monitor performance against budgets and provide actionable insights Cross-Functional Support - Act as a finance business partner to support potential synergies within the investments. - Collaborate with Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams on contract structures, pricing models, and financial implications - Support strategic initiatives related to expansion, innovation, and optimization of new investments Process Improvement & Systems - Improve financial processes, reporting automation, and data quality across investment activities - Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, reporting tools, or financial systems as needed - Identify opportunities to scale finance processes as new businesses grow Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (CPA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent strongly preferred) with a Big 4 background - 6–10 years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including exposure to investments, or multi-entity environments - Experience in hospitality, travel, cruise, retail, consumer services, or asset-heavy industries is a strong plus - Solid understanding of financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting - Strong knowledge of IFRS accounting principles and financial controls - Fluent in English, French and/or Italian are a plus Your Essentials - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset - Diese Rolle spielt eine wichtige Rolle bei der Gewährleistung einer starken Finanzkontrolle und der Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um die Profitabilität über den nicht-Kern-Kreuzfahrtbetrieb zu optimieren. Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Buchhaltung oder verwandten Bereich (CPA, ACA, ACCA, oder ähnlich stark bevorzugt) mit einem Big 4 Hintergrund - 6–10 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Finanz- und Rechnungslegung, einschließlich der Exposition gegenüber Investitionen oder Multi-Tentity-Umgebungen - Erfahrung in der Gastgewerbe-, Reise-, Kreuzfahrt-, Einzelhandels-, Verbraucher- oder Asset-Heavy-Industrie ist ein starkes Plus - Solides Verständnis der Finanzmodellierung, Budgetierung, Prognosen und Managementberichterstattung - Starke Kenntnis der IFRS-Rechnungsgrundsätze und Finanzkontrollen - Fluent auf Englisch, Französisch und/oder Italienisch sind ein Plus Ihre Essenzen - Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit einem kommerziellen Denkansatz - Fähigkeit, Finanzdaten in klare Einblicke für nichtfinanzielle Interessengruppen zu übersetzen - Komfortables Arbeiten in einer schnelllebigen, sich entwickelnden Umgebung mit mehreren Stakeholdern - descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le gestionnaire des finances et de la comptabilité – Nouveaux investissements dirigera la surveillance financière, la comptabilité et la gestion du rendement de la société. Ce rôle joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise en place de contrôles financiers solides et dans le partenariat avec des équipes interfonctionnelles afin d'optimiser la rentabilité des croisières non essentielles. Le candidat idéal apporte un mélange d'expertise technique en comptabilité, de finance commerciale et d'expérience soutenant des environnements axés sur l'investissement ou multi-entreprises. Votre impact Gestion financière et rapports - Superviser la comptabilité, la clôture du mois et l'information financière pour SVCI - Veiller à la comptabilisation exacte des recettes, à la répartition des coûts et à l'analyse de la marge pour l'ICVV - Préparer et examiner les rapports de gestion, les ICR et les analyses des écarts pour appuyer les décisions opérationnelles - Maintenir le respect des contrôles internes, des normes comptables et des politiques de l'entreprise Nouveaux investissements et évaluation des entreprises - Suivre le rendement après investissement par rapport au plan et identifier les risques et les possibilités d'amélioration Budget et prévisions - Aider les investissements et le groupe dans les processus de budgétisation et de prévision glissante - Collaborer avec les dirigeants opérationnels pour élaborer des hypothèses réalistes et des objectifs financiers - Surveiller le rendement par rapport aux budgets et fournir des renseignements concrets Soutien transversal - Agir en tant que partenaire financier pour soutenir les synergies potentielles au sein des investissements. - Collaborer avec les équipes juridiques, du Trésor, des Opérations et du Commerce sur les structures contractuelles, les modèles de tarification et les implications financières - Soutenir les initiatives stratégiques liées à l'expansion, à l'innovation et à l'optimisation des nouveaux investissements Amélioration des processus et systèmes - Améliorer les processus financiers, l'automatisation des rapports et la qualité des données dans toutes les activités d'investissement - Appuyer la mise en œuvre ou l'amélioration du PGI, des outils d'établissement de rapports ou des systèmes financiers au besoin - Identifier les possibilités d'étendre les processus de financement à mesure que les nouvelles entreprises grandissent Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - Maîtrise en finance, comptabilité ou domaine connexe (CPA, ACA, ACCA ou l'équivalent fortement préféré) avec une formation Big 4 - 6-10 ans d'expérience progressive en finance et en comptabilité, y compris l'exposition aux investissements ou aux environnements multi-entités - Expérience dans les secteurs de l'hôtellerie, des voyages, des croisières, du commerce de détail, des services à la consommation ou des biens lourds est un plus fort - Bonne compréhension de la modélisation financière, de la budgétisation, des prévisions et des rapports de gestion - Forte connaissance des principes comptables et des contrôles financiers des IFRS - L'anglais, le français et/ou l'italien sont un plus Vos essentiels - Fortes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec une mentalité commerciale - Capacité de traduire les données financières en idées claires pour les intervenants non financiers - Travail confortable dans un environnement en évolution rapide avec de multiples parties prenantes - Haute attention au détail avec la possibilité de voir le grand tableau - Excellentes compétences en communication et en relation Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Vice President Global SPA and Wellness è il proprietario di business globale per tutte le operazioni di SPA, benessere, bellezza e fitness a bordo della Divisione Crociera di MSC Group, che comprende MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) e Explora Journeys (Luxury). Il ruolo ha piena responsabilità per i programmi SPA e di trattamento, aree fitness e termali, servizi di salone, vendita al dettaglio benessere, estetica medica (dove applicabile), e future offerte di benessere digitale. Questa posizione garantisce che gli standard di lusso per il benessere, i rituali di servizio, l'eccellenza terapeutica e le filosofie olistiche per il benessere siano completamente incorporati, in particolare per Explora Journeys, pur mantenendo ambienti benessere scalabili e differenziati dal marchio in tutta la flotta. Il VP definisce la visione globale di SPA e benessere a lungo termine, spinge le prestazioni commerciali, eleva la soddisfazione degli ospiti, ed evolve concetti di benessere che differenziano la Divisione Crociera di MSC Group attraverso segmenti contemporanei, premium e di lusso. Il tuo impatto Leadership strategica e commerciale - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di SPA e benessere attraverso marchi contemporanei, premium e di lusso, allineati con profili ospiti differenziati e posizionamento del marchio. - Agire come proprietario di business per Global SPA e Wellness, con responsabilità esplicita per i concetti e gli standard di lusso. - Proprio la roadmap commerciale end-to-end, tra cui l'architettura del trattamento, la strategia dei prezzi, le promozioni, l'ottimizzazione della capacità e la progettazione del viaggio degli ospiti end-to-end. - Condurre trattative strategiche con gli operatori SPA, partner benessere, fornitori di estetica medica (dove consentito), marchi di prodotto e fornitori di attrezzature. - Crescita dell'azionamento in categorie di benessere ad alto livello e premium, tra cui trattamenti firma, estetica medica, programmi di fitness e longevità, vendita al dettaglio di benessere e viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Sviluppare framework SPA e wellness scalabili ma distinguibili, consentendo la distribuzione selettiva di concetti premium e di lusso attraverso MSC Cruises e Explora Journeys. Eccellenza operativa e di marca - Superare le operazioni SPA a livello di flotta, assicurando la fornitura di servizi coerenti, la qualità del trattamento, gli standard igienici e la soddisfazione degli ospiti. - Definire standard di servizio, requisiti di certificazione terapeutica, programmi di formazione e benchmark di prestazioni in tutti i formati SPA. - Assicurare l'eccellenza del benessere di lusso per i viaggi Explora, inclusi rituali di servizio, condotta terapeutica, programmazione olistica, norme sulla privacy e ambienti benessere immersivi. - Introdurre concetti di benessere specifici, rituali di firma e lusso, programmazione esperienziale e trattamenti ispirati alla destinazione. - Assicurare la disponibilità della flotta per nuove costruzioni e banchine a secco, tra cui progettazione di layout SPA, selezione di attrezzature, pianificazione CAPEX e attivazione del concetto. Gestione finanziaria - Possedere la P&L completa per SPA e Wellness in tutti i marchi della Divisione Crociera, inclusi budget annui, target di ricavi, miglioramento dei margini e controllo dei costi. - Ottimizzare la produttività del terapeuta, il mix di trattamento, la disciplina dei prezzi, i tassi di attaccamento al dettaglio, i modelli di personale e l'economia di concessione. - Leva analisi avanzate per guidare la previsione della domanda, la gestione dei rendimenti, la segmentazione degli ospiti, l'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni e le prestazioni del trattamento. Collaborazione trasversale - Partner a stretto contatto con i team Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance e Newbuild per integrare il benessere nell'esperienza complessiva degli ospiti. - Collabora con i team CRM e Digital nell'impegno pre-cruise wellness, nell'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni a bordo e nei viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Allineare le offerte SPA con itinerario, destinazione e programmazione a bordo per massimizzare la differenziazione di rilevanza e le entrate. Leadership & Sviluppo organizzativo - Guidare un QQ globale e la flotta SPA e l'organizzazione benessere, tra cui team di strategia, operazioni, formazione e gestione dei partner. - Costruisci una cultura dell'eccellenza del servizio guest-centric, della gestione del benessere di lusso, della disciplina commerciale e dell'innovazione continua. - Mentor senior leader e rafforzare le capacità tra le operazioni SPA, lo sviluppo del concetto di benessere di lusso e la gestione delle prestazioni guidata dai dati. Il tuo viaggio finora - 15+ anni di esperienza di leadership senior in SPA, benessere, ospitalità, crociera, o multi-sito servizi business. - Proven successo proprietario di P&L complessi e la redditività di guida in ambienti orientati al servizio. - Profonda competenza nelle operazioni SPA, programmazione del benessere, gestione della qualità dei servizi e standard di esperienza degli ospiti di lusso. - Forte esperienza nella gestione di operatori di terze parti, modelli di concessione, o partnership di fornitori globali. I tuoi essenziali - Eccellente leadership, negoziazione e competenze di gestione degli stakeholder interfunzionali. - Volontà di viaggiare e operare in un ambiente internazionale veloce. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Vice President Global SPA and Wellness is the global business owner for all onboard SPA, wellness, beauty, and fitness operations across the Cruise Division of MSC Group, spanning MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) and Explora Journeys (Luxury). The role has full accountability for SPA and treatment programs, fitness and thermal areas, salon services, wellness retail, medical aesthetics (where applicable), and future digital wellness offerings. This position ensures that luxury wellness standards, service rituals, therapeutic excellence, and holistic wellbeing philosophies are fully embedded—particularly for Explora Journeys—while maintaining scalable, brand-differentiated wellness frameworks across the fleet. The VP defines the long-term global SPA and wellness vision, drives commercial performance, elevates guest satisfaction, and evolves wellness concepts that differentiate MSC Group’s Cruise Division across contemporary, premium, and luxury segments. Your Impact Strategic & Commercial Leadership - Define and lead the global SPA and wellness strategy across contemporary, premium, and luxury brands, aligned with differentiated guest profiles and brand positioning. - Act as business owner for Global SPA and Wellness, with explicit accountability for luxury wellness concepts and standards. - Own the end-to-end commercial roadmap, including treatment architecture, pricing strategy, promotions, capacity optimisation, and end-to-end guest journey design. - Lead strategic negotiations with SPA operators, wellness partners, medical aesthetics providers (where permitted), product brands, and equipment suppliers. - Drive growth in high-margin and premium wellness categories, including signature treatments, medical aesthetics, fitness and longevity programs, wellness retail, and personalised wellbeing journeys. - Develop scalable yet brand-distinct SPA and wellness frameworks, enabling selective deployment of premium and luxury concepts across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys. Operational and Brand Excellence - Oversee SPA operations fleet-wide, ensuring consistent service delivery, treatment quality, hygiene standards, and guest satisfaction. - Define service standards, therapist certification requirements, training programs, and performance benchmarks across all SPA formats. - Ensure luxury wellness excellence for Explora Journeys, including service rituals, therapist conduct, holistic programming, privacy standards, and immersive wellness environments. - Introduce tier-specific wellness concepts, signature and luxury rituals, experiential programming, and destination-inspired treatments. - Ensure fleet readiness for newbuilds and dry docks, including SPA layout design, equipment selection, CAPEX planning, and concept activation. Financial Management - Own the full P&L for SPA and Wellness across all Cruise Division brands, including annual budgets, revenue targets, margin improvement, and cost control. - Optimise therapist productivity, treatment mix, pricing discipline, retail attachment rates, staffing models, and concession economics. - Leverage advanced analytics to drive demand forecasting, yield management, guest segmentation, booking optimisation, and treatment performance. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance, and Newbuild teams to integrate wellness into the overall guest experience. - Collaborate with CRM and Digital teams on pre-cruise wellness engagement, onboard booking optimisation, and personalised wellness journeys. - Align SPA offerings with itinerary, destination, and onboard programming to maximise relevance differentiation, and revenue. Leadership & Organisational Development - Lead a global HQ and fleet SPA and wellness organisation, including strategy, operations, training, and partner management teams. - Build a culture of guest-centric service excellence, luxury wellness stewardship, commercial discipline, and continuous innovation. - Mentor senior leaders and strengthen capabilities across SPA operations, luxury wellness concept development, and data-driven performance management. Your Journey so far - 15+ years senior leadership experience in SPA, wellness, hospitality, cruise, or multi-site service businesses. - Proven success owning complex P&Ls and driving profitability in service-led environments. - Deep expertise in SPA operations, wellness programming, service quality management, and luxury guest experience standards. - Strong experience managing third-party operators, concession models, or global vendor partnerships. Your Essentials - Excellent leadership, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills. - Willingness to travel extensively and operate in a fast-paced international environment. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Vice President Global SPA and Wellness ist der weltweite Geschäftsinhaber für alle an Bord von SPA, Wellness, Schönheit und Fitness-Operationen über die Cruise Division von MSC Group, über MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) und Explora Journeys (Luxury). Die Rolle hat die volle Rechenschaftspflicht für SPA- und Behandlungsprogramme, Fitness- und Wärmebereiche, Salondienste, Wellness-Einzelhandel, medizinische Ästhetik (sofern zutreffend) und zukünftige digitale Wellness-Angebote. Diese Position sorgt dafür, dass Luxus-Wellness-Standards, Service-Ritualitäten, therapeutische Exzellenz und ganzheitliche Wohlfahrtsphilosophien vollständig eingebettet sind – vor allem für Explora-Reises – und dabei skalierbare, branddifferenzierte Wellness-Frameworks in der gesamten Flotte erhalten. Die VP definiert die langfristige globale SPA- und Wellness-Vision, treibt kommerzielle Leistung, erhöht die Gästezufriedenheit und entwickelt Wellness-Konzepte, die die Cruise Division der MSC Group in zeitgenössischen, Premium- und Luxussegmenten differenzieren. Ihre Auswirkungen Strategische und kommerzielle Führung - Definieren und führen Sie die globale SPA- und Wellnessstrategie über moderne, Premium- und Luxusmarken, die mit differenzierten Gastprofilen und Markenpositionierung zusammenhängen. - Handeln Sie als Unternehmer für Global SPA und Wellness, mit ausdrücklicher Rechenschaftspflicht für Luxus-Wellness-Konzepte und -Standards. - Besitzen Sie die end-to-end-kommerzielle Roadmap, einschließlich Behandlungsarchitektur, Preisstrategie, Promotions, Kapazitätsoptimierung und End-to-End-Gastreise-Design. - Führen Sie strategische Verhandlungen mit SPA-Betreibern, Wellness-Partnern, medizinischen Ästhetik-Anbietern (sofern zulässig), Produktmarken und Geräteanbietern. - Antriebswachstum in High-Margin- und Premium-Wellness-Kategorien, einschließlich Signatur-Behandlungen, medizinische Ästhetik, Fitness- und Langlebigkeitsprogramme, Wellness-Einzelhandel und personalisierte Wohlbefindensreisen. - Entwickeln Sie skalierbare und dennoch branddistinct SPA- und Wellness-Frameworks, die eine selektive Bereitstellung von Premium- und Luxuskonzepten über MSC Cruises und Explora Journeys ermöglichen. Betriebs- und Markenexzellenz - Beaufsichtigen Sie die SPA-Operationen flottenweit und gewährleisten Sie eine konsequente Service-Lieferung, Behandlungsqualität, Hygienestandards und Gästezufriedenheit. - Definieren Sie Service-Standards, therapistische Zertifizierungsanforderungen, Schulungsprogramme und Leistungs-Benchmarks in allen SPA-Formaten. - Vergewissern Sie sich Luxus-Wellness-Exzellenz für Explora Journeys, einschließlich Service Rituale, Therapeutenverhalten, ganzheitliche Programmierung, Datenschutzstandards und immersive Wellness-Umgebungen. - Einführung tierspezifischer Wellness-Konzepte, Signaturen und Luxusrituale, experimentelle Programmierung und zielorientierte Behandlungen. - Gewährleistung der Flottenbereitschaft für Neubauten und Trockendocks, einschließlich SPA Layout-Design, Geräteauswahl, CAPEX-Planung und Konzeptaktivierung. Finanzmanagement - Besitzen Sie die volle P&L für SPA und Wellness auf allen Cruise Division Marken, einschließlich Jahresbudgets, Umsatzziele, Margenverbesserung und Kostenkontrolle. - Optimieren Sie die Produktivität der Therapeuten, den Behandlungsmix, die Preisdisziplin, die Anpassungsraten des Einzelhandels, die Personalmodelle und die Konzessionsökonomie. - Leverage fortschrittliche Analytik, um Nachfrageprognosen, Ertragsmanagement, Gastsegmentierung, Buchungsoptimierung und Behandlungsleistung zu steigern. Cross-Functionale Zusammenarbeit - Partner eng mit Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance und Newbuild-Teams, um Wellness in die Gesamt-Gasterlebnis zu integrieren. - Zusammenarbeit mit CRM- und Digital-Teams über das pre-cruise Wellness-Engagement, die Reservierungsoptimierung und personalisierte Wellness-Reises. - Align SPA bietet mit Routen-, Ziel- und Onboard-Programmierung, um die Relevanzdifferenzierung und Einnahmen zu maximieren. Führung und Organisationsentwicklung - Führen Sie eine globale HQ und Flotte SPA und Wellness-Organisation, einschließlich Strategie, Operationen, Schulungen und Partner-Management-Teams. - Bauen Sie eine Kultur der gastzentrierten Service-Exzellenz, Luxus-Wellness Stewardship, Handelsdisziplin und kontinuierliche Innovation. - Mentor leitende Führungskräfte und stärken die Fähigkeiten über SPA-Betriebe, luxuriöse Wellness-Konzept-Entwicklung und datengesteuertes Leistungsmanagement. Ihre Reise so weit - 15+ Jahre Führungserfahrung in SPA, Wellness, Gastfreundschaft, Kreuzfahrt oder Multi-Site-Service-Unternehmen. - Erprobter Erfolg, der komplexe P&Ls besitzt und die Rentabilität in betriebsgeführten Umgebungen treibt. - Tiefes Know-how in SPA-Betrieben, Wellness-Programmierung, Service-Qualitätsmanagement und Luxus-Gästeerlebnis-Standards. - Starke Erfahrung bei der Verwaltung von Drittanbietern, Konzessionsmodellen oder globalen Anbieterpartnerschaften. Ihre Essenzen - Ausgezeichnete Führungs-, Verhandlungs- und funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder Managementfähigkeiten. - Bereitschaft, umfassend zu reisen und in einem rasanten internationalen Umfeld zu betreiben. Unser Engagement Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre objectif Le vice-président Global SPA and Wellness est le propriétaire d'entreprise mondial pour toutes les opérations de SPA, de bien-être, de beauté et de fitness à bord de la division Croisières du groupe MSC, couvrant MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) et Explora Journeys (Luxury). Le rôle consiste à rendre pleinement compte des programmes de SPA et de traitement, des zones de conditionnement physique et thermique, des services de salon, de la vente au détail de bien-être, de l'esthétique médicale (le cas échéant) et des futures offres de bien-être numérique. Cette position garantit que les normes de bien-être de luxe, les rituels de service, l'excellence thérapeutique et les philosophies de bien-être holistiques sont entièrement intégrés, en particulier pour Explora Journeys, tout en maintenant des cadres de bien-être évolutifs et différenciés par la marque dans l'ensemble de la flotte. Le VP définit la vision globale à long terme du SPA et du bien-être, stimule la performance commerciale, élève la satisfaction des clients et développe des concepts de bien-être qui différencient la division Croisière du MSC sur les segments contemporains, premium et luxe. Votre impact Leadership stratégique et commercial - Définissez et dirigez la stratégie globale de SPA et de bien-être pour les marques contemporaines, premium et de luxe, alignées sur des profils d'invités différenciés et le positionnement de la marque. - Oui. Agir en tant que propriétaire d'entreprise pour Global SPA et Wellness, avec une responsabilité explicite pour les concepts et les normes de bien-être de luxe. - Posséder la feuille de route commerciale de bout en bout, y compris l'architecture de traitement, la stratégie de tarification, les promotions, l'optimisation des capacités, et la conception de voyage de bout en bout. - Diriger les négociations stratégiques avec les opérateurs de SPA, les partenaires de bien-être, les fournisseurs d'esthétique médicale (si possible), les marques de produits et les fournisseurs d'équipement. - Favoriser la croissance dans les catégories de bien-être haut de gamme et haut de gamme, y compris les traitements de signature, l'esthétique médicale, les programmes de conditionnement physique et de longévité, le commerce de détail de bien-être et les voyages personnalisés de bien-être. - Développer des cadres de SPA et de bien-être évolutifs mais distincts, permettant un déploiement sélectif de concepts haut de gamme et de luxe à travers MSC Cruises et Explora Journeys. Excellence en matière d'exploitation et d'image de marque - Surveiller les opérations de SPA dans toute la flotte, en assurant une prestation de services uniforme, la qualité du traitement, les normes d'hygiène et la satisfaction des clients. - Définir les normes de service, les exigences de certification des thérapeutes, les programmes de formation et les repères de rendement pour tous les formats de SPA. - Assurer l'excellence en bien-être de luxe pour Explora Journeys, y compris les rituels de service, la conduite des thérapeutes, la programmation holistique, les normes de confidentialité et les environnements de bien-être immersifs. - Introduire des concepts de bien-être spécifiques, des rituels de signature et de luxe, une programmation expérientielle et des traitements inspirés de la destination. - Assurer l'état de préparation de la flotte pour les nouvelles constructions et les cales sèches, y compris la conception de l'aménagement du SPA, la sélection de l'équipement, la planification du CAPEX et l'activation du concept. Gestion financière - Posséder l'intégralité des P&L pour SPA et Wellness dans toutes les marques de la division Croisière, y compris les budgets annuels, les objectifs de revenus, l'amélioration de la marge et le contrôle des coûts. - Optimiser la productivité des thérapeutes, la combinaison de traitements, la discipline des prix, les taux d'attachement au détail, les modèles de dotation et l'économie de concession. - Tirer parti d'analyses avancées pour la prévision de la demande, la gestion des rendements, la segmentation des clients, l'optimisation des réservations et les performances de traitement. Collaboration interfonctionnelle - S'associer étroitement aux équipes des opérations hôtelières, de la médecine, de la condition physique, du commerce de détail, de F&B, de Shorex, du numérique, des finances et de Newbuild pour intégrer le bien-être à l'expérience globale des clients. - Collaborer avec les équipes CRM et Digital sur l'engagement de bien-être pré-cruise, l'optimisation des réservations à bord et des voyages de bien-être personnalisés. - Aligner les offres de SPA avec l'itinéraire, la destination et la programmation à bord pour maximiser la différenciation de pertinence et les revenus. Leadership & Développement organisationnel - Diriger un QG mondial et une flotte SPA et organisation de bien-être, y compris la stratégie, les opérations, la formation et les équipes de gestion partenaires. - Bâtir une culture d'excellence en matière de services axés sur les clients, d'intendance du bien-être de luxe, de discipline commerciale et d'innovation continue. - Mentor dirigeants et renforcer les capacités dans toutes les opérations SPA, le développement de concepts de bien-être de luxe et la gestion du rendement axée sur les données. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - 15+ ans d'expérience de leadership senior dans les entreprises de SPA, de bien-être, d'hospitalité, de croisière ou de services multi-site. - Succès prouvé possédant des P&L complexes et favorisant la rentabilité dans les environnements dirigés par les services. - Une expertise approfondie dans les opérations SPA, la programmation de bien-être, la gestion de la qualité du service et les normes d'expérience client de luxe. - Forte expérience en gestion d'opérateurs tiers, de modèles de concession ou de partenariats mondiaux avec des fournisseurs. Vos essentiels - Excellent leadership, négociation et compétences de gestion interfonctionnelles des intervenants. - Volonté de voyager largement et d'opérer dans un environnement international rapide. Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Sosterrai lo sviluppo di analisi strutturate e meccanismi di follow-up, lavorando a stretto contatto con il reparto Customer Journey e HR. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione pratica sia agli analytics orientati agli ospiti che ai dipendenti.

Il tuo impatto

Viaggio dei clienti:

- Sostenere le analisi del Customer Journey ricorrenti, incluse le recensioni basate su tela, le analisi della nave di mezza stagione e i responsabili dei comitati.

- Contribuire a analisi approfondite ad hoc su argomenti specifici, segmenti ospiti, nazionalità o navi, in base alle richieste di business e gestione.

- Preparare estrazioni di dati, grafici, tabelle e uscite analitiche di primo livello utilizzando modelli standardizzati.

- Mantenere i tracker di analisi del Customer Journey, assicurando la documentazione corretta, il controllo della versione e il monitoraggio dei piani di azione.

- Supporta analisi e aggiornamenti di follow-up dopo i piloti, modifiche operative o feedback di gestione.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la consistenza e l'allineamento attraverso il Customer Journey consegnabili e reporting.

Il nostro programma BEST:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il monitoraggio dei framework KPI per il nostro programma BEST.

- Consolidare e analizzare i dati provenienti da più fonti, inclusi i sondaggi di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti, il feedback dei nostri clienti, la formazione di NPS e i relativi indicatori degli ospiti.

- Costruire, aggiornare e mantenere le dashboard per monitorare le prestazioni del programma, l'impegno e l'impatto nel tempo.

- Produrre rapporti regolari di performance e riassunti esecutivi strutturati per le recensioni di leadership.

- Assicurare la coerenza dei dati, la precisione e gli standard di report in tutti i nostri output di analisi BEST.

- Sostenere la preparazione di visualizzazioni di dati e materiali di storytelling per gli stakeholder senior.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea (o attualmente iscritta) in Business, Data Analytics, Ospitalità o un campo relativo

- Forte mentalità analitica con attenzione ai dettagli

- Avanzate competenze di Excel; la conoscenza degli strumenti di dashboard (ad esempio Power BI, Tableau) è un plus

- Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di tradurre i dati in insight strutturati

- Fluente in inglese

I tuoi essenziali

Competenze consigliate

- No.
Conoscenza di base delle metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e NPS

- No.
Comprensione di base delle metriche di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti

- Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione e reporting dati

- Interessi nel viaggio dei clienti, nell'esperienza degli ospiti e nel miglioramento dei servizi

- Familiarità con l'analisi dei dati dell'indagine e l'analisi a risposta aperta

Cosa ti offre questo ruolo:

- Esperienza pratica nell'analisi, sviluppo KPI e dashboard

- Esposizione all'impatto reale del business attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati

- Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente globale e dinamico

Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le Directeur des opérations est responsable de la conception, de la mobilisation, de l'ouverture et de l'exploitation continue de grands équipements de croisière et d'accueil. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

• Scout e contrarre TOs/DMC attraverso offerte strutturate e trattative

• Assicurare che i prodotti riflettano le realtà a bordo (timing, demografie degli ospiti, considerazioni sulla mobilità)

• Monitorare il feedback degli ospiti e implementare azioni correttive Gestione finanziaria e delle prestazioni
